title: DSAEval: Evaluating Data Science Agents on a Wide Range of Real-World Data Science Problems
abstract: arXiv:2601.13591v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent LLM-based data agents aim to automate data science tasks ranging from data analysis to deep learning. However, the open-ended nature of real-world data science problems, which often span multiple taxonomies and lack standard answers, poses a significant challenge for evaluation. To address this, we introduce DSAEval, a benchmark comprising 641 real-world data science problems grounded in 285 diverse datasets, covering both structured and unstructured data (e.g., image and text). DSAEval incorporates three distinctive features: (1) Multimodal Environment Perception, which enables agents to interpret observations from multiple modalities, including text and vision; (2) Multi-Query Interactions, which mirror the iterative and cumulative nature of real-world data science projects; and (3) Multi-Dimensional Evaluation, which provides a holistic assessment across reasoning, code, and results. translated_title: DSAEval：在广泛的真实世界数据科学问题上评估数据科学智能体
translated_abstract: 近年来的基于大语言模型（LLM）的数据智能体旨在自动化从数据分析到深度学习的各种数据科学任务。然而，真实世界数据科学问题的开放性——这些问题往往跨越多个类别且缺乏标准答案——给评估带来了重大挑战。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 DSAEval，这是一个包含 641 个真实世界数据科学问题的基准，这些问题基于 285 个多样化的数据集，涵盖结构化和非结构化数据（例如图像和文本）。DSAEval 具有三个独特特性：（1）多模态环境感知，使智能体能够解读来自文本和视觉等多种模态的观测信息；（2）多查询交互，反映了真实世界数据科学项目的迭代性和累积性；（3）多维度评估，从推理、代码和结果三个层面提供全面评估。我们系统地评估了 13 个最新的先进……
tldr: DSAEval 是一个包含 641 个真实数据科学问题、覆盖多模态数据，并通过多模态感知、多查询交互和多维度评估来全面评测基于 LLM 的数据科学智能体的新基准。
en_tdlr: DSAEval is a new benchmark of 641 real-world data science problems spanning 285 diverse datasets that comprehensively evaluates LLM-based data science agents through multimodal environment perception, multi-query interactions, and multi-dimensional evaluation.
